thread:
Priya: Heads-up 10am PT sprint: need a lightweight benchmark asset pack for the Apr 14 launch. Deliverables: 1 hero stat card (social + slide crop), 2x static social tiles, 1 email banner, and a one-slide benchmark explainer. Can design pick this up?
Liam: We can. What's the single most important stat to lead with?
Priya: Use median latency 65ms and cost per 1k tokens $0.06 as lead facts. Emphasize 'predictable performance' and 'cost transparency'.
Sofia: Copy constraints: 1) avoid absolutes (Legal will flag), 2) keep hero to 10 words, 3) supply alt text.
Legal: Confirmed. Replace "fastest" with "industry-leading" or omit. All metric claims need a link to the benchmark CSV in the asset package.
Priya: I'll attach CSV + benchmark notes to the folder.
Design-bot: New Figma page created by Liam: "Benchpack-Apr14" https://figma.com/file/benchpack-apr14 node:12
Liam: Visual direction: simple bar + sparkline for trend, use iconography for 'cost' and 'latency'. No gradients; follow brand core palette.
Sofia: Also need 2x social copy variants for A/B testing. Keep one short for X and one longer for LinkedIn.
Priya: Copy options: ["Ship consistent inference: median latency 65ms. Register Apr 14.", "See predictable inference economics. Live demo + benchmarks on Apr 14."]
Liam: Timeline: first drafts by Tue noon, final assets by Thu EOD for localization handoff. Exports: PNG 1200x675 (social), 800x200 (email banner), PPTX slide.
Ops: For inbound mapping: use source=bench_apr14 and route leads to queue "apac-sdr" if region=APAC else "bench-sdr". Hidden field: bench_variant.
Design-bot: Accessibility reminder: ensure 4.5:1 text contrast, provide alt copy in asset manifest.
Priya: Uploading data + copy now: https://drive.redwood/marketing/bench_apr14.csv
Liam: Will put drafts into Figma and ping here when ready.
Legal: I'll review metric phrasing once draft is in Figma.
Priya: Thanks team 1: please drop final approved assets into /marketing-assets/bench_apr14 by Friday.
